description: Azure Core provides the shared primitives, abstractions, and helpers used by modern Java Azure SDK client libraries, including the HTTP pipeline, authentication, serialization, tracing, and exception handling. Individual Azure service client libraries depend on it rather than reimplementing this common infrastructure themselves.
